channel.title: Pain001: Open-Source ISO 20022 Payment Initiation Suite
channel.description: Generate schema-validated ISO 20022 pain.001 and pain.008 XML from CSV, Excel, SQLite, JSON, Parquet, or SWIFT MT101 — with AI-agent MCP tools and editor LSP support.

item.title: ISO 20022 example files — pain.001 and pain.008 samples per country and rail
item.description: Download ISO 20022 pain.001 and pain.008 sample files built from the public scheme rulebooks per country and rail, each with a record of where it comes from and how it was checked, plus schema coverage files for every supported edition.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: ISO 20022 schema coverage files — every element of every edition
item.description: Generated pain.001 and pain.008 files that between them use every element path and choice branch of each supported schema edition, each named after what it adds, with a zip per edition.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Accessibility Statement
item.description: pain001.com targets WCAG 2.2 AAA, enforced as a build gate: measured 7:1 contrast in both themes, pa11y-verified pages, keyboard-first interaction, and an open channel for reports.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Architecture, Security and the Patent Landscape
item.description: Zero-trust XML parsing, decimal-exact arithmetic, validation as a hard gate, 100% branch coverage — and where Pain001 sits amid patented MT–MX transformation services.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Browse Pain001 Topics
item.description: Every page tagged and grouped — ISO 20022 versions, SEPA rulebooks, SWIFT migration, AI tooling. Pick a topic and follow the thread.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Compatibility Matrix
item.description: Exactly what Pain001 supports: every message definition with generate/validate/migrate coverage, input formats, scheme rulebooks, address models, and the known limitations — verified against the shipped code.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Contact Pain001: Support, Security and Enquiries
item.description: Where to report bugs, disclose security issues privately, and reach the maintainer — with what to include for the fastest possible fix.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Cross-Border pain.001 Under CBPR+: a Field Guide
item.description: What CBPR+ requires of your pain.001: BICFI agents, structured or hybrid addresses from 14 Nov 2026, charge bearers, purpose codes — with a worked xborder-ct example.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)
